_comment: Egg: Hermes On-Demand Listener (Telegram polling). Installs deps and runs bot.py. Fill vars in panel: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERS, GH_PAT, GH_REPO.
name: Hermes On-Demand Listener
author: azascloud-cell
description: Lightweight Telegram polling bot that triggers the Hermes on-demand GitHub Actions workflow. Runs in low-RAM (125MB) environments.

installation.script:
# @author azascloud-cell
# @description Hermes On-Demand Listener egg installer

apt update
apt install -y curl

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "Installing Python dependencies..."
pip install --no-cache-dir -r listener/requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || pip install --no-cache-dir requests

echo "Installation complete."

variables.name: Allowed Telegram Users
variables.description: Comma-separated numeric Telegram user IDs allowed to use the bot

variables.name: GitHub PAT
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope (for repository_dispatch)

variables.name: GitHub Repo
variables.description: Repo in form owner/repo, e.g. azascloud-cell/hermes-ondemand
